products.name: Aviator Classic
products.description: Originally crafted for U.S. aviators in 1937, combining high-grade teardrop metallurgy with legendary G-15 optical clarity. Engineered with authentic crown optical crystal and arista gold electroplating.

products.name: Original Wayfarer Classic
products.description: The most recognizable style in the history of sunglasses. Hand-carved and polished Italian Mazzucchelli acetate with distinct trapezoidal silhouette and functional front silver rivets.

products.name: Hexagonal Flat Lenses
products.description: The geometric evolution of round eyewear. Precision coined metal profile with crystal flat lenses, custom filigree bridge, and acetate temple tips.

products.name: Round Metal Legend
products.description: A counterculture retro legend worn by legendary musicians and artists. Features a curved brow bar, adjustable silicone nose pads, and ultra-lightweight coined metal temples.

products.name: Radar EV Path Prizm™
products.description: Olympic-grade sports eyewear with revolutionary tall single shield Plutonite® lens, lightweight O Matter™ stress-resistant frame, and hydrophilic Unobtainium® ear-socks.

reviews.author: Alexander M.
reviews.title: The gold standard of sunglasses - fitting mirror was spot on
reviews.comment: The virtual try-on IPD scaling was remarkably precise. Looked in the mirror tool and when it arrived in the mail it sat on my face exactly the same. Crystal clear optics and solid arista gold finish.

reviews.author: Elena R.
reviews.title: Timeless luxury and stunning green G-15 tint
reviews.comment: The G-15 green lenses provide unparalleled contrast under harsh sunlight. High-quality spring hinges and comfortable silicone nose pads.

reviews.author: Marcus K.
reviews.title: Iconic Italian acetate that matches any outfit
reviews.comment: Substantial weight, hand-polished finish, and unmistakable silhouette. The virtual mirror helped me choose between 50mm and 54mm with confidence.

reviews.author: Chloe S.
reviews.title: Modern and edgy twist on the round style
reviews.comment: Flat crystal lenses catch the light so beautifully! Super lightweight and compliments my cheekbones perfectly.
